outgoing.name: Arabic language
outgoing.excerpt: El refers to the chief Semitic deity, while Gabal meaning mountain (compare with the Hebrew gevul and Arabic jebel) is his Emesene manifestation.

outgoing.name: Hebrew language
outgoing.excerpt: El refers to the chief Semitic deity, while Gabal meaning mountain (compare with the Hebrew gevul and Arabic jebel) is his Emesene manifestation.

outgoing.name: Italy
outgoing.excerpt: Macrinus fled toward Italy, disguised as a courier.

outgoing.name: Latin
outgoing.excerpt: The name Elagabalus is a Latin form of the name of the Semitic god El-Gabal.

outgoing.name: Roman mythology
outgoing.excerpt: He replaced Jupiter, head of the Roman pantheon, with a new god, Deus Sol Invictus, which in Latin means "the Sun, Undefeated God".

outgoing.name: Rome
outgoing.excerpt: Letters of reconciliation were dispatched to Rome extending amnesty to the Senate and recognizing the laws.

outgoing.name: Augustus
outgoing.excerpt: …and Julia Soaemias were elevated to the rank of Augustae, and the memory of Macrinus and Diadumenianus was…

outgoing.name: Syria
outgoing.excerpt: …was the high priest at Emesa (modern Homs) in Syria.
